**Established (conditionally).** `cor:nonzero-field` in `boundary-detection.tex` proves the clause "at least one smeared field is nonzero" of `ex-reconstructed`. The union image u of the unit class at one grade d₀ is nonzero, and Φ(u,f) ≠ 0 for some Schwartz f. The proof uses three things: the one-point word with the unit law and normalization; the injectivity of E_{d₀} → E that `prop:boundary-detection` already assumes; and the contrapositive of `prop:boundary-detection` with the field formula of `prop:word-fields`. This is the source route `YM.Table.alive` → `YM.Table.pin_inj` → faithfulness (`HierarchyBridge.publicReconstruction`). No existing statement changed.

It has no producer in the manuscript. `prop:ex-limits-euclidean` covers normalization but not the unit law. Proposed owner: the C03 limits author. I did not check the finite-lattice definition of the unit insertion, so the passage to the limit is only a proposal. In the source the law is part of the premise `Seed.kernel : S.Hierarchy`.
- E4 and the F1 wording (PR #203) are untouched.
